cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Drop the Armor
cards.instruction: Persuade someone to lower their guard, stop performing strength, or admit what affects them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The shop's locked. You can stop the cheerful voice now. Please put the till drawer down; counting it a third time won't add a customer.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Someone has to keep morale up. You're my only employee.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've clocked off. You're addressing a friend now, not staff. Start again: how did today feel?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I cried in the stockroom. Then I practised smiling before you came back.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No more rehearsal, please. Sit here, where you don't have to hide. You can tell me about the stockroom without putting that voice back on.
